Definition: from G4862 and G2564; to convoke:--call together.
BiblicalUsage: When the shepherd finds his sheep he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying, Rejoice with me, and after three days in Rome Paul calls the chief of the Jews together to speak with them. Calling together is for rejoicing and for reasoning, and the church does both.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God calls His people together to rejoice and to reason, and I hold that both are part of the same fellowship.
